_comment: Shared case table for the unused-asset rule (INACTIVE-001).
extension/shared/inactivity.js and app/src/lib/inactivity.ts are two copies
of one rule, because the dashboard cannot import extension source
(app/CLAUDE.md section 6). Both read THIS file and must produce the same
answers: scripts/check-inactivity-parity.js runs it against the extension
module, app/src/__tests__/inactivity.test.ts against the TypeScript one.
Every date sits weeks away from a threshold boundary on purpose. The rule
counts calendar months via setMonth, which resolves in local time, so a
fixture placed hours from the cutoff would pass in one timezone and fail in
another without either implementation being wrong.

expect._case: default 6 months: oldest first, snoozed hidden, undated skipped
messages: You have never used ::abc. Added 5 May 2024.
You have never used Welcome note. Added 1 June 2025.
You have not used Quote reply since 5 January 2026.
You have not used Late checkout since 10 February 2026.

expect._case: 9 months: the two January/February dates fall inside the window
messages: You have never used ::abc. Added 5 May 2024.
You have never used Welcome note. Added 1 June 2025.
